name: agent-loop
description: Run your sprint's tickets in parallel: each ticket is planned, built, checked by independent reviewers and fixed until they agree, and you approve only the pull requests. Trello, Jira, GitHub Projects or a local file. Experimental outside Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Project brief plus a parallel ticket loop
interface.longDescription: Start every session already knowing the board, sprint goal, client requirements, open PRs and what other agents did; then plan, implement, review and fix tickets from Trello, GitHub Projects, Jira or a local file in parallel worktrees, with Claude Code, Codex or Cursor running each stage, and ship them on one confirmation.
